schema.text: Is there a place for people to walk along this street?

options.text: No walking space – people must walk on the road
Walking area at the same level as the road

en.#Is there a place for people to walk alo: Is there a place for people to walk along this street?
en.#No walking space – people must walk on: No walking space – people must walk on the road
en.#Walking area at the same level as the r: Walking area at the same level as the road

it.#Is there a place for people to walk alo: C'è uno spazio in cui camminare lungo questa strada?
it.#No walking space – people must walk on: Non c'è uno spazio pedonale: occorre camminare sulla carreggiata
it.#Shared walking and cycling path: Percorso condiviso da persone a piedi e in bicicletta
it.#Walking area at the same level as the r: Spazio pedonale allo stesso livello della carreggiata
it.#Dedicated walking street or area: Strada o area riservata alle persone a piedi

fr.#Is there a place for people to walk alo: Y a-t-il un espace où les personnes peuvent marcher le long de cette rue ?
fr.#No walking space – people must walk on: Aucun espace piéton : il faut marcher sur la chaussée
fr.#Shared walking and cycling path: Chemin partagé pour la marche et le vélo
fr.#Walking area at the same level as the r: Espace piéton au même niveau que la chaussée
fr.#Dedicated walking street or area: Rue ou zone réservée aux piétons

de.#Is there a place for people to walk alo: Gibt es entlang dieser Straße einen Bereich zum Gehen?
de.#No walking space – people must walk on: Kein Gehbereich – Personen müssen auf der Fahrbahn gehen
de.#Walking area at the same level as the r: Gehbereich auf gleicher Höhe wie die Fahrbahn

tr.#Is there a place for people to walk alo: Bu sokak boyunca insanların yürüyebileceği bir alan var mı?
tr.#No walking space – people must walk on: Yürüme alanı yok – insanlar yolda yürümek zorunda
tr.#Walking area at the same level as the r: Yürüyüş alanı yol ile aynı seviyede

fa.#Is there a place for people to walk alo: آیا در امتداد این خیابان فضایی برای پیاده‌روی وجود دارد؟
fa.#No walking space – people must walk on: فضای پیاده وجود ندارد – مردم باید در جاده راه بروند
fa.#Road shoulder available for walking: شانه خیابان برای پیاده‌روی قابل استفاده است
fa.#Walking area at the same level as the r: فضای پیاده در همان سطح خیابان

hu.#Is there a place for people to walk alo: Van gyaloglásra alkalmas hely ezen az utcán?
hu.#No walking space – people must walk on: Nincs gyalogos tér – az úttesten kell gyalogolni
hu.#Walking area at the same level as the r: Gyalogos terület az úttal azonos szinten

ar.#Is there a place for people to walk alo: هل توجد مساحة للمشي على طول هذا الشارع؟
ar.#No walking space – people must walk on: لا توجد مساحة للمشي – يجب على الناس المشي في الطريق
ar.#Walking area at the same level as the r: مساحة مشاة على نفس مستوى الطريق
